to become, to come to be (one of kāna's sisters, with an accusative predicate); literally to enter upon the morning, to wake up
I know — 1st sg. of عَلِمَ (ʕalima); also أَعْلَمَ (ʔaʕlama) to inform, to notify; and the elative أَعْلَم more knowledgeable, best-informed (الله أعلم “God knows best”)
to go bankrupt, to become insolvent, to fail financially
to worry, to disturb, to trouble; to alarm, to unsettle
pain, ache (m., pl. آلام); also أ + لم, “didn't …?”, the question hamza on the negative لم, as in ألم أقل لك؟ “Didn't I tell you?”; and ʔalima, to be in pain, to ache
matter, affair, business (m.; pl. أمور) — ما الأمر؟ what's the matter?; order, command (m.; pl. أوامر); also the verb أمَرَ to order, to command, to instruct
to be possible for (someone), can, may — almost always impersonal: يمكن أن it is possible that, يمكنك you can (يمكنك أن تفعلها — you can do it); also to enable (someone مِن to do something)
to, that (before a verb); that (after say, think, know)
to slight, to disrespect, to insult, to abuse; to slur; to offend, to affront

to invent, to devise, to originate, to innovate
celebration, ceremony, festival (verbal noun of اِحْتَفَلَ, form VIII)
now, right now; at present, at the moment; up to now (حتى الآن)

the city (definite of مَدِينَة); Medina (the holy city in Saudi Arabia)
used after quotes, translations, etc, to indicate that the original text was modified and is not transferred exactly as it appears in the original material i.e. paraphrased.

to stay, to remain, to be left; to last, to endure, to continue to exist
to show interest in, to be receptive; to reply to, to echo
to move, to be in motion; to set off, to depart
say..., I wonder... (precedes a yes-or-no question, sometimes follows يَا (yā))
Chile (a country in South America)

to learn (something); also you know, do you know — 2nd sg. m. of عَلِمَ (ʕalima)
you are, she is; (after أن) to be — imperfect of كَانَ (kāna); also تَكَوَّنَ (takawwana) to be formed, to consist of (من)

instantaneousness, immediacy
chandelier; the Pleiades

grandfather (جَدّ, m.; pl. أجداد); seriousness, earnestness (جِدّ) — بجدّ hard, in earnest (عمل بجد he worked hard), على محمل الجد seriously; also جِدّ 'very' before an adjective, though ordinary 'very' comes after the adjective and is spelled جدًّا, which is its own card
a surface where grain sheaves or dates are collected, a heap of harvest (Ḥijāzi and Yemenite form of جُرْن)
to make (someone do something), to cause; to put, to place, to set; (before a non-past verb) to begin to
general (a military officer)

love, affection (m.), as in الحب; also ʔaḥabba / yuḥibb, to love, to like; and ḥabb, grains, seeds, ḥabba, a grain, a pill

good, fine, handsome (adj. حَسَن, f. حسنة); also the Form II verb حسَّن to improve, to make better (حسّن معرفته he improved his knowledge); and the noun حُسْن goodness, beauty — حسن الحظ good luck
to happen, to occur, to take place; (with على) to get, to obtain, to receive
right, entitlement (m.; pl. حقوق) — يحق لـ to have the right to; truth, what is right (الحق معك you are right); حقًّا really, truly; also the verb حَقَّ to be true, to be due
campaign (f.), whether military, electoral or advertising; an attack, charge, offensive; also ḥamala, plural of حامل: bearers, holders
to go out, to leave, to exit (with مِن “out of”); to come out, to emerge; to go forth, to depart
to die out, to grow faint; to become low in volume or inaudible
inside, within (prep.); the inside, the interior (n., m.), as in في الداخل “indoors”; also the active participle of دخل, entering, incoming; and (rare) dāḵala, to befall, to come over
a tie, a thing with which one ties; a ribat (a frontier post where travellers and soldiers could stay)
to request, to ask politely, as in أرجوك “please” and يُرجى / الرجاء “kindly, please”; to hope for, to wish for
man (m.; pl. رِجال); also رِجْل leg, foot (f.; pl. أرجُل); rarely the verb رَجِلَ to go on foot
(with ما or لا) to still be, to still be doing — ما زال / لا يزال “he is still …”; on its own to go away, to disappear, to cease
Semitic; Sami (a male given name)
cause, reason, motive (m., pl. أسباب); بسبب because of, on account of; also the verb سبَّب (sabbaba) to cause, to bring about
blackboard, whiteboard; slate
person, individual (m.; pl. أشخاص) — أي شخص anyone, شخص ما someone; also the verb شخَّص to diagnose, to identify
to feel, to sense (بـ something); to notice, to realize; also the nouns شَعْر hair (m.) and شِعْر poetry (m.)
shape, form, figure (m., pl. أشكال); kind, sort; بشكل — in a … way, as in بشكل عام “generally”; also šakkala, to form, to shape, to constitute
nature, disposition, character (m., pl. طِباع); بالطبع / طبعًا — of course, naturally; also ṭabaʕa, to print, to stamp, to imprint, to type (طباعة printing, مطبعة press)
to ask for, to request; to order (food, goods); to demand, to require; to seek, to look for; also the noun ṭalab, request, application, order (m., pl. طلبات)
on, on top of; against; must, have to (with a pronoun ending)
on me; I have to, I must (على + ـي); also Ali (male given name) and عَلِيّ high, lofty, exalted (adj.)
higher, highest, upper (feminine of أَعْلَى)
work, job, labour (m.; pl. أعمال); deed, act, action; also the verb عَمِلَ to work, to do, to make (يعمل he works, أعمل I work)
about, concerning; away from, off
Fez (the capital city of the region of Fez-Meknes, Morocco)
favor, kindness, merit (m.), as in مِن فضلك “please”; also faḍḍala, to prefer, to favor one over another; and (rare) faḍala, to remain, to be left over
to carry out, to do, to undertake — قام بـ + verbal noun is the ordinary way to say 'do' (قام بزيارة he paid a visit); to stand up, to rise, to get up
before, prior to (prep.) — قبل أن before (+ verb), من قبل before, previously; ago (قبل سنة a year ago); also the verb قَبِلَ to accept, to agree to

to present, to offer, to submit; to introduce (someone); also the noun qadam, foot (f., pl. أقدام), as in كرة القدم “football”; and qadima, to arrive, to come forward, to precede
shirt (a sleeved upper-body garment)
Kabul (the capital city of Afghanistan; alternative spelling of كَابُل)

a female given name, Leila, Laila, or Layla
what?; what, that which; not (negates a past verb)
vat, wide-bellied bowl, trough

like, similar to (مِثْل + noun or pronoun — أنا مثله I am like him); such as, for example (مثلًا for example); مَثَل proverb, example (m.; pl. أمثال); also the verb مثَّل to represent, to act (a role)
affliction, adversity, tribulation; distress
placenta; the sac enclosing the fetus during gestation
angels (plural of مَلْأَك / مَلَك)
from, out of; some of (partitive); than (in comparisons); who?, whoever
yes; yes indeed, certainly (answering a question, and answering when called — نعم؟ yes?); also نَعَم livestock, cattle (m.) and the verb نَعِمَ to live in comfort
self (f.; pl. أنفُس, نفوس) — the reflexive: نفسي myself, بنفسه by himself; the same (الوقت نفسه the same time); soul, psyche; also نَفَس breath (m.)
kind, type, sort (m., pl. أنواع); species, variety; as in أي نوع من “what kind of”; also nawwaʕa, to diversify, to vary
Nice (a city in southeast France)
to attack (used with على)
this, this one (feminine); these (with non-human plurals)

face (m., pl. وجوه); side, aspect, as in وجهة نظر “point of view”; also waǧǧaha, to direct, to aim, to address (a question, a charge), to send
to let, to allow, to leave alone — chiefly the imperative دَعْ (daʕ): دعني أرى “let me see”; also وَدَّعَ (waddaʕa) to say goodbye to, to bid farewell, to see off
to arrive, to reach, to get to (إلى somewhere); to connect, to join, to link up; to deliver, to convey

helping (gerund of ajudar): ella m'està ajudant molt, she's helping me a lot; also (m., f.) helper, assistant
this; this one (feminine — aquesta casa, this house)
murder, killing (m.); assassination; also murdered, killed (past participle of assassinar): va ser assassinat, he was murdered

drunk, having drunk (past participle of beure): he begut massa cafè, I've drunk too much coffee; also drunk, tipsy, intoxicated

clear, bright, light-coloured (feminine singular of clar): l'elecció està clara, the choice is clear; also (f.) white of an egg

he/she/it believes, thinks (third-person singular present indicative of creure): creu que sí, he thinks so; believe! (second-person singular imperative): creu-me, believe me; also (f.) cross

left, let (past participle of deixar); also slovenly, unkempt

said, told (past participle of dir); also (m.) finger, toe
woman (f.); wife; also gives (third-person singular present indicative of donar, written dóna before the 2016 reform)
giving (gerund of donar): estava donant un discurs, she was giving a speech; also (m., f.) donor, giver
in, at (preposition); of it, of them (pronoun); the (before a man's name)

been (past participle of estar and of ser); also (m.) state, condition; the State, government
I am (first-person singular present indicative of estar — state, location, ongoing action); also (m.) hockey stick
is; he/she/it is (from estar — a temporary state or condition, or where someone is right now: està cansat, he's tired)

hands (f., plural of mà); also tame, docile

he/she/it kills (third-person singular present indicative of matar); kill! (second-person singular imperative): això em mata, this is killing me; also (f.) bush, shrub

he/she/it eats (third-person singular present indicative of menjar): ell no menja carn, he doesn't eat meat; eat! (second-person singular imperative): menja menjar ràpid, eat fast food; also (f.) dish, a tasty or fancy one
mind (f.): tenir en ment, to bear in mind; the spirit; also he/she/it lies, is lying (third-person singular present indicative of mentir)
a female given name

dead; died (past participle of morir, also used as an adjective); also (f.) death: la pena de mort, the death penalty
he/she/it shows (third-person singular present indicative of mostrar); show! (second-person singular imperative): mostra'm com es fa, show me how it's done; also (f.) sample, specimen; sign, display
not (negating a verb); no (in answer to a question)
open, not closed: el supermercat és obert, the supermarket is open; opened (past participle of obrir): he obert la porta, I've opened the door; also open in the sense of frank, not hidden
Oliver (a male given name); also (m.) olive tree
peaceful, pacific; (el Pacífic) the Pacific Ocean

speaking (gerund of parlar): estic parlant, I am talking; also (m., f.) speaker, one who speaks

last, past (feminine singular of passat): la setmana passada, last week; also (f.) a pass, a going-over; una passada, colloquially, something amazing
happening, going on; passing (gerund of passar): què està passant?, what's happening?; also (m., f.) passer-by
happened, passed (past participle of passar); last, past: el mes passat, last month; also (m.) the past
he/she/it thinks (third-person singular present indicative of pensar); think! (second-person singular imperative); also (f.) mind, the faculty of thought
but; however, though
full (feminine of ple): l'ampolla està plena, the bottle is full; full, complete: plena confiança, full confidence; also (f.) in castells, the column to the right of the rengla
door (f.); gate, gateway; also he/she/it carries, brings, wears (third-person singular present indicative of portar)
he/she/it puts, places (third-person singular present indicative of posar); put! (second-person singular imperative): posa la cadira aquí, put the chair here; also (f.) pose
put, placed, set (past participle of posar): hem posat un nou sostre, we've put on a new roof; also (m.) air, look, demeanour
he/she/it can, is able to (third-person singular present indicative of poder); also (m.) pot, jar, tin
question (f.); also he/she/it asks (third-person singular present indicative of preguntar); ask! (second-person singular imperative): pregunta-li, ask him

he/she/it goes up, climbs, rises; raises, puts up (third-person singular present indicative of pujar); get in!, go up! (second-person singular imperative): puja al cotxe, get in the car; also (f.) rise, increase

which?, what? (feminine singular of quin); also (f.) quina, a bingo-like game played at Christmas

clothes, clothing (f.): la roba bruta, the dirty laundry; cloth, fabric; also he/she/it steals (third-person singular present indicative of robar)

healthy, wholesome: menjar sa, healthy food; sa i estalvi, safe and sound; also his, her (unstressed possessive, before a kinship noun): sa mare, his mother; and, in Balearic, the feminine article 'the'

heard, felt (past participle of sentir); also (m.) sense; meaning: no té sentit, it makes no sense
if; whether (in indirect questions)

asked for, ordered - past participle of pedir (no he pedido esto, I didn't order this; me ha pedido ayuda, he asked me for help); also el pedido: an order for goods
I think (from pensar - pienso que si, I think so); pienso en ti - I'm thinking of you; pienso + infinitive - I plan to, I intend to; also el pienso, animal feed
legs - plural of la pierna (mis piernas son largas, my legs are long; estirar las piernas, to stretch your legs)
I put, I place; I put on (clothes) - from poner (me pongo los pantalones, I put on my trousers); me pongo - I get, I become (me pongo nervioso, I get nervous)
first (feminine - la primera vez, the first time); also la primera: first gear, first class
he/she/it can, is able to; you can (formal) - from poder; puede que + subjunctive - maybe, it could be

put, placed; put on (clothes) - past participle of poner (donde he puesto las llaves? - where have I put the keys?; lleva puesto un abrigo azul, he has a blue coat on); el puesto - a job or post (es perfecto para el puesto, he's just right for the job), a place or rank, a market stall; puesto que - since, given that
terrible, awful, dreadful (the superlative of malo)

remains, is left - from quedar (casi no queda vino, there's hardly any wine left); queda bien - it fits, it suits (esta ropa te queda bien, these clothes suit you); is located, is (por donde queda la playa? - which way is the beach?); also el toque de queda, a curfew
I stay, I remain; I'm keeping it, I'll take it - from quedar(se) (me quedo con esto, I'll take this one); also quedo: quiet, still (literary)

wanted; loved - past participle of querer (siempre he querido cantar, I've always wanted to sing; nunca le ha querido nadie, nobody has ever loved him); dear (querido amigo - dear friend, opening a letter); querido - darling, sweetheart

who? - plural of quién, for more than one person (¿quiénes son estas personas?, who are these people?); whom? (as an object: ¿a quiénes viste?)
I remember (from recordar - lo recuerdo bien, I remember it well; recuerdo haberla visto, I remember seeing her); no recuerdo - I can't remember; also el recuerdo: a memory, a keepsake or souvenir
prayer; also I pray (from rezar)
red (feminine - la casa roja, the red house); ponerse roja - to blush, to go red; also la Roja: the Spanish national side (in sport)
you know (from saber - facts, information, how to do something); sabes? - you know?, right? (as a tag)
known, found out - past participle of saber (si lo hubiera sabido, if I had known); heard (no he sabido nada de ella, I haven't heard from her); es sabido que - it is well known that
salt (pasame la sal - pass me the salt; echa mas sal a la sopa - add more salt to the soup); also get out!, leave!, go out! - familiar imperative of salir (sal de mi camino, get out of my way)
may go out, that I/he/she leave - present subjunctive of salir (espero que salga bien, I hope it turns out well; cuando salga, when he leaves); ¡salga! - get out! (formal imperative)

gone out, left - past participle of salir (yo había salido, I had gone out; el tren ya había salido, the train had already left); salir bien/mal - to turn out well/badly (algo ha salido mal, something's gone wrong); recién salido de - fresh out of; also salido: sticking out, and vulgar horny

safe - nearly always in a salvo (estas a salvo, you're safe; sano y salvo, safe and sound); except, apart from (nada es seguro salvo la muerte, nothing is certain except death); salvo que - unless, except that; also I save, I rescue - from salvar
himself, herself, themselves (reflexive); one, people (impersonal); to him/her
second (feminine - la segunda vez, the second time; de segunda mano, second-hand; la Segunda Guerra Mundial); also la segunda: second gear

sense, meaning (no tiene sentido - that makes no sense; en cierto sentido - in a sense); sense, faculty (sentido del humor - sense of humour; sexto sentido - sixth sense); sin sentido - senseless, meaningless; direction, way (sentido de la orientacion - sense of direction; un solo sentido - one way); also felt - past participle of sentir (no me he sentido bien, I haven't felt well)
they are; you are (ustedes) - from ser, for identity and lasting traits; son las dos - it's two o'clock; also el son, an Afro-Cuban musical form

times, instances - plural of vez; a veces - sometimes; muchas veces - often; tres veces - three times

to see me - the infinitive ver plus me (ven a verme mañana, come and see me tomorrow; puedo verme en el espejo, I can see myself in the mirror)

America, the Americas (the continent); also America, the United States
second-person singular present of avoir — you have (tu as); also the helper for the past: tu as mangé = you ate; (as noun, m.) an ace, a card of value 1

(m.) wood, the material (une table en bois = a wooden table); a wood, the woods (dans les bois); also je/tu bois, bois ! = I/you drink, drink! (from boire)
Brazil (a large Portuguese-speaking country in South America)
a type of headwear once popular with Beguines, similar to a bonnet

short (c'est trop court = that's too short); à court de = short of (à court d'idées = out of ideas, à court d'argent = short of money); also runs — third-person singular present of courir (ce chien court très vite = that dog runs very fast); (as noun, m.) a tennis court

CV, curriculum vitae; also horsepower (cheval-vapeur, cheval fiscal)

knocks, hits — from frapper (on frappe à la porte = someone's knocking at the door; frappe-moi ! = hit me!; la mort frappe tous les hommes = death comes to all men); (as noun, f.) a strike, a shot, a keystroke

Jules (a male given name, equivalent to English Julius); (informal) boyfriend

past participle of prendre — took, taken (j'ai pris = I took); (as adj.) taken, occupied (la place est prise)

feminine past participle of prendre — took, taken (je l'ai prise = I took it, I took her; la place est prise = the seat is taken); (as noun, f.) a socket, a power point (prise électrique); a grip, a hold; prise de sang = blood test

leaves, leave — from quitter (il quitte la société = he's leaving the company; ne me quitte pas ! = don't leave me!; je te quitte demain = I'm leaving you tomorrow); (as adj.) quits, square — être quitte envers quelqu'un = to be even with someone; quitte à = even if it means

past participle of rendre — gave back, returned (je lui ai rendu son livre = I gave him back his book); made (j'ai rendu John heureux = I made John happy); rendre visite à = to pay a visit to; (as noun, m.) a render, the finished look of something
stays, remains — from rester (je reste, il reste; reste ici = stay here); il reste beaucoup à faire = much remains to be done; (as noun, m.) the rest, the remainder

past participle of recevoir — received, got (j'ai reçu ta lettre = I got your letter; bien reçu = message received); (as noun, m.) a receipt; (as adj.) accepted, widely held (une idée reçue = a conventional idea, received wisdom)
a river (f.) — one flowing into a lake or a larger river, not into the sea
a male given name, feminine equivalent Roberte, equivalent to English Robert
siesta, afternoon nap (f.)
sister; nun (f.) — nonstandard spelling of sœur

third-person singular present subjunctive of être — (that it) be: il faut que ce soit fait = it has to be done; quoi que ce soit = anything at all; soit A soit B = either A or B

third-person singular present of sortir — goes out, comes out (il sort ce soir = he's going out tonight; ça sort d'où ? = where does that come from?); (as noun, m.) fate, destiny; a spell (jeter un sort = to cast a spell)

(f.) sort, kind, type (une sorte de = a sort of; toutes sortes de = all kinds of); en quelque sorte = in a way; de sorte que, faire en sorte que = so that, to see to it that; also que je/il sorte = that I/he go out (subjunctive of sortir)
a female given name, masculine equivalent Stéphane [=Stephen], equivalent to English Stephanie
I am (from être); also I follow (from suivre - same form, different verb)

past participle of suivre — followed (je l'ai suivi dans sa chambre = I followed him into his room); took (il a suivi mon conseil = he took my advice; suivre un cours = to take a course); (as noun, m.) follow-up, monitoring, tracking
Sweden (the country); lowercase le suède, suede (the leather)
you, to you; yourself (the form te takes before a vowel: je t'aime)
past participle of tirer — pulled, drawn, shot (il a tiré trois fois = he fired three shots; tiré par les cheveux = far-fetched); être tiré d'affaire = to be out of trouble, off the hook
falls, fall — from tomber (il tombe = he falls; la nuit tombe = night is falling; ça tombe bien = that's good timing); tomber amoureux = to fall in love; (as noun, f.) a grave, a tomb

feminine past participle of tomber — fell, fallen (une pièce est tombée de sa poche = a coin fell out of his pocket; elle est tombée amoureuse = she fell in love; Paris est tombée en 1940 = Paris fell in 1940); (as noun, f.) à la tombée de la nuit = at nightfall
touches, touch — from toucher (ne touche pas à ça = don't touch that; ça me touche = that moves me); (as noun, f.) a key, a button (on a keyboard); a touch, a stroke; en touche = out of play
you (singular, informal — vous is the polite form)
a, an (masculine); one (the number)
a, an (feminine); one (the number)
third-person singular present of aller — goes (ça va = it's fine, how are you?); il va + infinitive = he is going to (on va voir = we'll see); also the singular imperative: va = go!
feminine past participle of venir — came, come (elle est venue = she came; une idée m'est venue = an idea came to me); (as noun, f.) a coming, an arrival (la venue du printemps)

first- and second-person singular present of vivre — I live, you live (je vis ici depuis dix ans = I've lived here for ten years; c'est là que tu vis = that's where you live); also the past historic of voir: je vis = I saw (literary); (as noun, f.) a screw
vow; wish (m.) — nonstandard spelling of vœu
wishes, vows — plural of vœu, spelled here without the ligature
there (a place already mentioned); to it, about it; il y a = there is, there are
a female given name, equivalent to English Zoë
but; however, yet (opens the contrasting clause, and can begin a sentence)
two (invariable for gender; na biyu m. / ta biyu f. = second, sau biyu = twice)

women — plural of mace 'woman': Mata suna da gaskiya 'women are sincere'; also mata (f.) 'a man's wife'; and 'to her, for her', the 3sg f. indirect-object pronoun, after the verb: Ya rubuta mata sako 'he wrote her a message'
some, a certain, another (f.) — the feminine of wani, before a feminine noun: wata rana 'one day', wata hanya 'another way'; also the separate masculine noun wata 'moon, month' (pl. watanni)

son of — construct form of ɗa (m.) 'son' (f. ʼyar, pl. ʼyan): ɗan Musa 'Musa's son'; before a place, trade or activity it names a person of it: ɗan Nijeriya 'a Nigerian', ɗan kasuwa 'trader'; also a diminutive, ɗan ƙaramin gida 'a smallish house', and 'a little, just' before a verb: ɗan tsaya 'wait a bit'
but; however, yet — marks a contrast with what was just said
or — links alternatives; doubled (או…או) it means either…or
one (m.; the feminine is אחת) — follows its noun; also a certain one, someone
other, another — f. sg. of אחר (שפה אחרת = 'another language'); also, as an adverb, otherwise, differently
how, in what way — asks manner, not quantity (how much/many is כמה)
motion toward someone or something ('turned ___ the wall'), as a separate word, not the prefix; also 'don't' before a command
if; whether — opens a condition or an indirect question
we (men and women alike; formal writing also uses אנו)
I (men and women alike; gender shows on the present-tense verb or adjective that follows)
that, which — the relative pronoun; the formal counterpart of ש־, introducing a subordinate clause
one-letter prefix for being in or at a place or time — '___ the house', '___ the morning'; also by means of ('wrote ___ pen')
everyday spoken word for whose sake something is done — 'I bought it ___ you'; not the prefix ל, and not the formal עבור / למען
to grow, to grow up (נולד וגדל בחיפה = 'born and raised in Haifa'); to become big, to increase
the (definite article; a prefix that rides on the noun and on its adjectives)

to protect, to defend — הגן על 'defended, stood up for'; also simply ה־ + גן: the garden, the park, the kindergarten — הגן הלאומי 'the national park' — and in biology the gene — הגן עם המוטציה 'the gene carrying the mutation'
he; also used as present-tense copula “is” (masculine)
go; walk (m. sg. present — 'is going', 'is walking')
attaches after a definite feminine noun to point at it — 'the woman ___' = this woman; the standalone form is זאת
attaches after a definite masculine noun to point at it — 'the book ___' = this book; the standalone form is זה
she; it (of a feminine noun); is — the linking word in "Dana is a teacher"
and; and then (a prefix — it attaches to the front of the next word)

friend (m.); member of a body or party (חבר כנסת = a Knesset member, היה חבר ב־ = was a member of); boyfriend; in construct, the body itself — חבר המושבעים the jury, חבר העמים the Commonwealth; also the verb חָבַר, joined, teamed up with (ל־)

laws of — construct plural of חוק (law, m.): חוקי הטבע 'the laws of nature', חוקי המדינה 'the laws of the state', חוקי היסוד 'the Basic Laws'; also an adjective: legal, lawful, permitted by law — בלתי חוקי 'illegal'
animals (f. pl. of חיה) — חיות בר 'wild animals', חיות מחמד 'pets', גן חיות 'a zoo'; also the f. pl. of חי: live, living — הופעות חיות 'live performances'

to occur, to take place, to set in (of a change or trend) — חל שינוי 'a change occurred', חל שיפור 'an improvement took place'; also: to apply, to be in force (of a law or ban) — החוק חל על 'the law applies to'; and to fall on (of a date)
good — f. sg. of טוב (עבודה טובה = 'good work'); also, as a noun (f.), a favour, a kindness
knowledge (m.) — what is known, expertise; also the past-tense verb ידע, 'he knew' (from לדעת)
day (m.; pl. ימים); daytime, as opposed to night; a day of the week or of the month
marks the comparative — placed by an adjective for 'bigger/better than'; also 'to a greater degree' ('work ___')
created, made, formed (3rd m. sg. past of יצר) — יצר קשר 'made contact', יצר את 'created the…'; as a noun (m.): instinct, urge, drive — יצר הרע 'the evil inclination'
old (of things)
in this place — the more formal, written-sounding of the two words for it; the colloquial one is פה
including, inclusive of (כולל מע“מ = 'VAT included'); comprehensive, overall (ביטוח כולל); includes — m. sg. present of כלל
yes (in reply); so, thus — as in "if so", "likewise"
one-letter prefix marking a destination or recipient — 'went ___ Haifa', 'gave it ___ Dana'; also builds the infinitive
why, what for — asks a reason; the formal written word is מדוע
in or toward a lower position, standing alone with no noun after it — 'look ___', 'the shop ___ (downstairs)'
in or toward a higher position, standing alone with no noun after it — 'look ___', 'the neighbours ___ (upstairs)'
one-letter prefix marking a source or starting point — 'came ___ Haifa', 'left ___ home', 'bigger ___ this'
a kind of food, one item among many — 'the spicy ___s of this region'; not the mass word אוכל, not a served portion מנה

leads, leads to (m. sg. present of הוביל) — הדבר מוביל ל 'this leads to', מוביל את הקבוצה 'leads the team'; as an adjective: leading, foremost — חוקר מוביל 'a leading researcher'; as a noun (m.): a carrier, conduit — המוביל הארצי 'the National Water Carrier'
absolute, total — רוב מוחלט 'an absolute majority', באופן מוחלט 'absolutely', כישלון מוחלט 'a total failure'; also: definitive, decided

headquarters, (military) staff (m.) — ראש מטה 'chief of staff', קצין מטה 'a staff officer', מטה הבחירות 'campaign HQ'; and as an adverb: down, downwards — כלפי מטה 'downward'; the staff/rod sense is biblical
who, whom (the question word); whoever, anyone who
separate, more literary word for source or origin, standing before its noun ('___ the sea'); the everyday version is the prefix מ
succeeds, manages to (m. sg. present of הצליח; normally followed by an infinitive) — מצליח להימלט 'manages to escape', אינו מצליח 'does not manage'; as an adjective: successful, thriving

changes, alters — m./f. sg. present of שינה (לא משנה = 'it makes no difference'); as the second word of a compound, sub-, secondary, deputy — ועדת משנה a sub-committee, קבלן משנה a subcontractor, כותרת משנה a subtitle, אלוף משנה a colonel; also the Mishnah, the core text of the Talmud, though that is normally written המשנה
uses, makes use of (m. sg. present of השתמש, always with ב־) — משתמש במחשב 'uses a computer', אינו משתמש ב 'does not use'; as a noun (m.): a user — ממשק משתמש 'user interface'
describes, depicts (m. sg. present of תיאר) — הספר מתאר את 'the book describes'; as a noun (m.): an outline, a contour — תוכנית מתאר 'a master plan', קווי מתאר 'contour lines'

married (a woman) — נשא לאישה / נשא את X לאישה, the commonest use by far in biographical prose: הוא נשא לאישה את בת דודתו 'he married his cousin'; also to carry, to bear, to lift; נשא נאום 'delivered a speech', נשא בתואר 'held the title'

her book — ספר (book, m.) with the 3rd f. sg. possessive suffix: ספרה הראשון 'her first book', את ספרה 'her book'; as a noun in its own right (f.): a digit, a single numeral; rarely: a sphere, a domain
now, right now; at this moment — as opposed to earlier or later
in this place — the everyday spoken word, interchangeable with כאן; the same spelling is also the word for mouth
to turn to, to approach, to appeal to — פנה אל 'turned to, addressed'; to turn, to head (in a direction); to take up (a field) — פנה להוראה 'went into teaching'
private, personal — רכב פרטי 'a private car', באופן פרטי 'privately'; also the construct plural of פרט: details of, items of — פרטי התוכנית 'the details of the plan', פרטי לבוש 'items of clothing'
axis (m.) — סביב ציר 'around an axis', ציר הזמן 'the timeline', ציר הסימטריה 'the axis of symmetry'; a route, thoroughfare — ציר ז'בוטינסקי; also: a pivot, a hinge; a delegate, envoy
needs to, has to, must (f. sg. of צריך; before an infinitive) — היא צריכה להיות 'she has to be', הייתה צריכה 'she had to'; as a noun (f.): consumption, demand — מוצרי צריכה 'consumer goods'
to determine, to decide, to rule (בית המשפט קבע = 'the court ruled'); to set (a date, a record); also the noun kéva (m.), permanence or permanent status — צבא קבע, the career army
of; belonging to
supported, backed (3rd m. sg. past of תמך; with ב־) — תמך במועמד 'backed a candidate', לא תמך ב 'did not support'; also: to hold up, to prop up; as a noun (m.): a prop, a structural support
one's own — my, your, his, her, their own (always refers back to the subject)
this (the form used before a postposition: इस घर में — in this house)
Urdu (language)
him, her, it; to him, to her (also marks the one who needs or feels something)
one; a, an (a certain); single, sole
and; more, extra; other, different

do — the stem of करना, standing before रहा, सकना and the vector verbs (कर रहे हैं — are doing, कर सकते हो — you can do); also the conjunctive participle -कर, having done; and, as a literary noun, hand, arm (m.); tax (m.)
doing, to do (infinitive before a postposition: करने के लिए — in order to do)
said — masculine singular perfective of कहना (उसने कहा — he said; तुमने क्या कहा? — what did you say?); also a noun (m.): someone's word or bidding, as in कहा मानना — to do as one is told
the Indian National Congress
did, made (past; under ने it agrees with a masculine singular object)
of, 's, belonging to (before a feminine noun); also did, made (past of करना)
of, 's, belonging to (before a masculine plural or oblique noun); also starts compound postpositions: के लिए — for, के साथ — with
eats, eat — masculine singular habitual participle of खाना, with हूँ/है (मैं चीज़ खाता हूँ — I eat cheese); also a noun: account, ledger (m.), as in a bank account (खाता खोलो — open an account)
God; also a male given name, Jagdish
you, to you (the तुम level — friends and peers)
tooth (m.) — the anusvāra spelling of दाँत (गला हुआ दांत — the decayed tooth; दाँत साफ़ करना — to brush one's teeth); separately, a Sanskritic adjective: dental; restrained, subdued

gave — masculine singular perfective of देना (मैंने कुछ नहीं दिया — I gave nothing); as a completive vector after a stem it says the act was carried through: कर दिया — went and did it, छोड़ दिया — dropped it; also an oil lamp (m.), also spelled दीया

gave — feminine singular perfective of देना, agreeing with a feminine object under ने (उसने चेतावनी दी — he gave a warning); most often the completive vector taking that same agreement: नौकरी छोड़ दी — quit the job; also short for दीदी, elder sister (f.)
give — the stem of देना, standing before सकना, रहा and the vector verbs (नहीं दे सकता — I can't give, दे दो — give it here); also second/third-person singular present subjunctive: may give
two (2); also give! — the तुम imperative of देना, and the same form as a completive vector: दे दो — hand it over, छोड़ दो — let it go, कर दो — just do it
new — feminine singular of नया, agreeing with a feminine noun (मेरी नई गाड़ी — my new car; कुछ नई बात? — anything new?)
on, at (after a noun); but, however

got, obtained; was able to — masculine singular perfective of पाना, and after a bare stem the “managed to, could” construction (वह मदद नहीं कर पाया — he couldn't help; मैं उसे समझा पाया — I managed to make him understand); also a noun: the leg or foot of a piece of furniture (m.)
whole, complete, full — feminine of पूरा, agreeing with a feminine noun (पूरी रात — all night, पूरी तरह से — completely); also a puri (f.), the small deep-fried bread
good, well — oblique/plural masculine of भला (तुम्हारे भले के लिये — for your own good; भले लोग — good people); and in भले (ही), the concessive: even if, even though, granted that

died; dead — masculine singular perfective of मरना (उसका बेटा कैसे मरा? — how did his son die?; मैं अभी तक मरा नहीं हूँ — I'm not dead yet; मरा हुआ — dead, deceased); also in मरा जा रहा हूँ — I'm dying of (hunger, thirst)

accept, agree, believe, obey — the stem of मानना, before लेना and जाना and in the imperative (मान लो — suppose, assume; हार मत मानो — don't give up; वह मान गया — he relented); also a noun: respect, honour; pride (m.), and in technical use a measure or value
me, to me; I, when needing or feeling something (मुझे भूख है — I am hungry)
my, mine (before plural or oblique masculine nouns: मेरे दोस्त — my friends)
-ing (progressive: कर रहा है — is doing, masculine singular); stayed, remained
-ing (progressive: कर रहे हैं — are doing, plural or respectful); stayed, remained
for, for the sake of (in के लिए); also took, taken (past of लेना)
reality; real, actual
changed, especially for the worse — damaged, impaired; mutilated, maimed
they, those; he, she (respectful, about one person)
can, be able to (after a bare stem; plural or respectful subject: कर सकते हैं)

learn — the stem of सीखना, standing before रहा, लेना and the vector verbs (वह क्या सीख रहा है? — what is he learning?; मैंने बजाना सीख लिया — I learned to play); also a noun: a lesson, a moral, a piece of advice (f.)
a surname, Sen; also falcon

sleep — the stem of सोना, before जाना, रहा and in the imperative (सो जाओ — go to sleep; वह सो रहा है — he is sleeping); also the correlative pronoun answering जो: that one, so, therefore (जो हुआ सो हुआ — what is done is done)
we, us; I (colloquial)
light (in weight) — masculine plural or oblique of हल्का (halkā)
yes; yeah, that's right (agreeing); yes? (answering when called)
am (the form of होना used with मैं)
is; there is (used with a singular subject; a plural subject takes हैं)
are (the form used with तुम); be!; may be, might be (subjunctive)
is, happens, tends to be — masculine singular habitual participle of होना (ऐसा होता है — that is how it is; कुछ नहीं होता — nothing happens); also the counterfactual, होता तो — had it been so
event, function; program, show (television, radio); agenda (of a meeting)
introduces the purpose or wish behind an action, in formal or written style; speech says supaya
or (joining alternatives in statements and questions)
introduces a reported statement after verbs like say, know or hope ('I heard ___ he left')
to lend a hand with someone's task, to assist; tolong is the word used to ask the favour
and (joining words, phrases, and whole clauses)
marks where something is — in, at, on ('___ Jakarta'); before a person or a time, pada does this job
to wish for, to long for — a felt desire, and the more formal word; mau is the plain everyday 'want'
if, in the event that (formal and written; everyday speech says kalau)
if; when, whenever; as for, speaking of (everyday; jika is the formal word)
you (singular, informal, for friends and peers; Anda is the polite form)
asks at what time something happens ('___ do you arrive?')
a word — the unit speech and vocabulary are counted in; also introduces a quoted speaker ('___ Budi, ...' = Budi says)
you, one person — the clipped, blunt form of songs, poetry and very close talk; kamu is the everyday informal
to go back to where one was; also the polite reply to a thank-you — pulang is going home specifically
asks for the reason ('___ are you late?'); the everyday spoken form, where mengapa is the formal one
at the moment that — joins a clause saying when the other happened ('___ I arrived, it was raining')
marks a comparison — more, -er ('this one is ___ expensive than that')
and so — heads the consequence clause, mostly formal or written ('if it rains, ___ we stay in')
asks which one out of several ('the red or the blue — ___?'); also the question root after di, ke and dari
each on their own part, respectively ('we paid for ourselves')
asks for the reason, in formal or written style; ordinary speech uses kenapa instead
to catch the meaning of what someone says ('I don't ___ the question'); paham is the firmer grasp
even though — concedes a fact the main clause overrides; the me- form carrying -pun, twin of walaupun
at, on — used before a time or a person ('___ Monday', 'it depends ___ him'), where di marks a place
to have a firm grasp of a subject; also the understanding itself; mengerti is catching a meaning
bound to be so, certain — the speaker's confidence that a fact holds ('he's ___ home by now')
follows what it limits — just, only ('two ___' = only two); also 'go ahead and' in an invitation
I, me — the polite, neutral word for oneself, safe with strangers; aku is the intimate one
in the role or capacity of ('she works ___ a nurse')
with the result that — links an outcome to its cause within one sentence ('it rained so hard ___ we stayed in'); jadi is the spoken 'so'
follows an adjective to intensify it ('good ___' = very good); also one time, on one occasion
all (before the noun); everyone, everything (standing on its own)
every one in a set, no member left out; the longer, se- prefixed form, standing before the noun ('___ day')
introduces the purpose of an action ('come early ___ we can talk'); the everyday word, agar the formal one
but; however (everyday form of the more formal tetapi)
of course, naturally — granting what the hearer already assumes, often followed by saja
to catch fire; burnt, on fire (ter- form of bakar 'to burn' — happens to the subject)
for, intended for; in order to, so as to (before a verb)
even though — concedes a fact the main clause overrides; the wa- form carrying -pun, twin of meskipun
yes; right?, isn't it? (tag at the end of a sentence); okay? (softening a request)
links a noun to the clause describing it ('the book ___ I read'); also picks out 'the one that'
to (indirect object); at, in (a place or time); to (before an infinitive)
we have ('___ due figli'); the auxiliary for our past ('___ visto' 'we saw')

Africa (the continent south of Europe and between the Atlantic and Indian Oceans)
contraction of a + il; to the, at the — al lavoro 'at work', andare al mare 'to go to the sea'; also with (an ingredient): pasta al pomodoro
a female given name, equivalent to English Alice; anchovy
contraction of a + la; to the, at the — alla stazione 'to the station', alla fine 'in the end'; also in the style of, à la: pollo alla cacciatora
so, well then, opening or resuming a remark ('___, che facciamo?'); at that time, back then
others, other people; other (masculine plural of altro): gli altri ragazzi 'the other boys', dove sono gli altri? 'where are the others?'; as a literary singular pronoun, someone else
friend (f.), female friend (feminine of amico): sei la mia migliore amica 'you're my best friend' — a romantic partner is la ragazza or la fidanzata
to leave, to go away (first-person form of andarsene, from andare + me + ne): voglio andarmene 'I want to leave', voglio soltanto andarmene a casa 'I just want to go home'
gone, went (feminine singular past participle of andare): è andata a casa 'she went home', se n'è andata 'she left'; also a noun: the outward journey — andata e ritorno 'round trip'
we go, we're going ('___ a casa'); let's go!, as a call to set off
